caption: The video captures a black-and-white amphibious vehicle branded "HUMDINGA," its boat-like pointed bow oriented to the right, running along a paved test track. A seated driver sits in the open-top cockpit as the vehicle moves steadily past a dark tree line and a strip of green grass. The side tracking camera keeps the vehicle roughly centered while smearing background and foreground into continuous horizontal motion blur. Red-and-white trackside cones begin to appear along the pavement edge partway through the run, streaking past behind the wheels. The footage then cuts to a wider, different-angle view of a curving stretch of track under open sky, where the same vehicle blurs past at the right edge.
relations: Vehicle traveling right on paved track -> background and foreground smear into horizontal motion blur.
Driver seated in open cockpit -> maintains position relative to moving vehicle body.
Trackside cones appearing along pavement edge -> streak past behind wheels as vehicle advances.
View cutting to wider curving track angle -> vehicle blurs past right edge under open sky.
